exact_dyadic_sum_method: Align nonzero mantissas at the least exponent and add shifted signed integers. No term is discarded or rounded.

unsupported_galois_premise.scope: Irreducibility modulo 2 proves a quartic field; 7 does not divide its polynomial discriminant, so the squarefree mod-7 pattern gives residue degrees 1 and 3. This excludes normality of the degree-four field.
